<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="rex-matriarchs-methods-rotations" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Rex Matriarchs - Methods &amp; Rotations</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/k1pBa3wBhP.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide covers active strategies and rotations for the Rex Matriarchs. There are two main strategies:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><strong><nowiki>Hybrid killing multiple Matriarchs</nowiki></strong></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Higher KPH at the cost of significantly higher effort</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Only applies to Rathis/Orikalka/Pthentraken (Osseous has a separate arena)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><strong><nowiki>Camping a single Matriarch</nowiki></strong></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Simpler and uses only 1 combat style at the cost of lower KPH</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="strategy-1-hybrid-killing-multiple-matriarchs"><ins><nowiki>Strategy 1: Hybrid killing multiple Matriarchs</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Alternate between a pair of Matriarchs to minimise wasted time during respawns. It is suggested to follow the rotations listed for each boss in the below section </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Strategy 2: Camping a single Matriarch</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Top tips:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If killing Rathis, you can target Rathis from range while moving towards her, and use defensives to build 100% adrenaline for your opening </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/PfhJG00n61s <nowiki>(example)</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If killing Rathis/Pthentraken, ensure you travel at the edge of the arena to prevent aggression from Orikalka</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="hybrid-presets"><ins><nowiki>Hybrid Presets</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Perked hybrid armour such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513204700980576266.png?v=1" alt="SliskeBody" title="SliskeBody" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556592073042821122.png?v=1" alt="AnimalegsSliske" title="AnimalegsSliske" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used, but will reduce KPH</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=j9LSOzS9FecS0eY1hoCh <nowiki>Orikalka/Pthentraken Preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="ranged" title="ranged" kind="icon" /><pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/8484f1a3c36d32c39777f5309d310d097be34f52f32c82379c6540c5d358edb6.webp" alt="Hybrid Ori/Phten" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=ZkjU34SQqrS98xoJbvDr <nowiki>Orikalka/Rathis Preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/084a3228fbb43f845e268430e7a6c8d0a0e78facb5b5b72d01ca1a525dd728fa.webp" alt="Hybrid Rathis/Ori" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=GNdGZ7K1XMXRgrpMrBkU <nowiki>Rathis/Pthentraken Preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="ranged" title="ranged" kind="icon" /><pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/3b77d932954deb30cfc91ac7ea0fb12993795bf3bcdf5629e8e7ab2540cdbb88.webp" alt="Hybrid Rathis/Phten" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="strategy-2-camping-a-single-matriarch"><ins><nowiki>Strategy 2: Camping a single Matriarch</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="single-matriarch-presets"><ins><nowiki>Single Matriarch Presets</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=qhBiUaM4XYwtCTOgntLZ <nowiki>Orikalka</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/d26c7f348d4fb546481e9a58b1c7f130b3ca6961a364cd94ee1ef4556d372149.webp" alt="Orikalka" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=nRMSdlne9qU1egI9Bb1o <nowiki>Rathis</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/5ca6dfdf2206dd1ed502f1887b316894fd65acc4ad4d66f72f83fc916c4bd39c.webp" alt="Rathis" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=O067jI2g4XQ5T8ii10cF <nowiki>Pthentraken</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/614d47b7d7ccca56defad522c567b50230253bfe012a90c8de991032ce6338c9.webp" alt="Phentraken" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=HgySggpatAWYi8yf9zB0 <nowiki>Osseous</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/04ae9cde604eaa67634bbe97000c92325a246d760cfd2f1400c23082923f5aa1.webp" alt="Osseous" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="orikalka"><ins><nowiki>Orikalka</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/982264010873376868.png?v=1" alt="orikalka" title="orikalka" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Proper use of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1" alt="tsunamiincite" title="tsunamiincite" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1357545000577011782.png?v=1" alt="temporalanomaly" title="temporalanomaly" kind="icon" /><nowiki> means your rotations will be varied</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Keep Orikalka entangled </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489526534154.png?v=1" alt="sbsstandards" title="sbsstandards" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1" alt="ent" title="ent" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to avoid </nowiki><em><nowiki>Frostbite</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you get </nowiki><em><nowiki>Frostbite</nowiki></em><nowiki>, be prepared to move away from the fissures and prioritise channeled abilities and stuns like </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Example Rotation</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>(tc) + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489526534154.png?v=1" alt="SBSStandards" title="SBSStandards" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1" alt="ent" title="ent" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1" alt="tsunamiincite" title="tsunamiincite" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="soa" title="soa" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1" alt="smoketendrils" title="smoketendrils" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809978966037.png?v=1" alt="wm" title="wm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1" alt="omnipowerigneous" title="omnipowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → improv</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="rathis"><ins><nowiki>Rathis</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stand in melee distance to avoid Rathis charging and stunning you </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /></p>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="pthentraken"><ins><nowiki>Pthentraken</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></h3>

</nowiki>

</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ensure you re-equip </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/970657245312467004.png?v=1" alt="necklaceofsalamancy" title="necklaceofsalamancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Example Rotation</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061862405931120.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftness" title="deathsswiftness" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → (tc) + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1" alt="deadshot" title="deadshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → improv</nowiki></p>
